entry.notRun: the relay transport; the spill worker thread is a stub, the spill buffer is the runtime's
entry.runs: encodePhoneSessionState / requestPhoneTranscriptPage over the snapshot delta encoder (prepend) and decoder; remoteToolOutput; viewIsStale; the host live window (requestLiveTranscriptWindow, windowTranscriptSnapshot, loadLiveTranscriptHead) over a transcript spill buffer with a stubbed worker, archiveItemsForCompaction

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.entry: mixdog-app-server thread/items/list paging and the phone transcript window: feed each case's rows and page requests; compare ids, byte counts, truncation fields, notes and wires (whole, or length + sha256 where the recording holds a fingerprint)

normalised.fingerprints: rows and wires over 2 KB are recorded as {jsonChars, sha256} (fp) or per-row {bytes, sha256} (rowFp), not whole, to keep the fixture small
